from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u093/system/state/workspace/programs/task-165988ac.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    wall = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v != 0)
    # The full-length color is the barrier; move each other connected object toward it.
    if all(v == wall for v in grid[0]):
        dr, dc = 1, 0
    elif all(v == wall for v in grid[-1]):
        dr, dc = -1, 0
    elif all(row[0] == wall for row in grid):
        dr, dc = 0, 1
    else:
        dr, dc = 0, -1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if not v or v == wall or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
                for a,b in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==v:
                        seen.add((a,b)); stack.append((a,b))
            comps.append((v,cells))
    comps.sort(key=lambda z: min(r*dr+c*dc for r,c in z[1]))
    for v,cells in comps:
        while True:
            nxt=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in cells]
            if any(not (0<=r<h and 0<=c<w) or out[r][c] != 0 for r,c in nxt): break
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=0
            cells=nxt
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=v
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
